={{ `WITH input AS (
  SELECT '${$json.normalizedQuestion.replace(/'/g, "''")}'::text AS normalized_question,
         '${$json.question.replace(/'/g, "''")}'::text AS question
), cache_hit AS (
  UPDATE portfolio_ai.chat_cache c
  SET hits = hits + 1, updated_at = now()
  FROM input i
  WHERE c.normalized_question = i.normalized_question
  RETURNING c.answer
), fact_map AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(key, value), '{}'::jsonb) AS data
  FROM portfolio_ai.facts
), fact_details AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_object_agg(
      key,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'category', category,
        'value', value,
        'metadata', metadata,
        'updated_at', updated_at
      )
    ),
    '{}'::jsonb
  ) AS data
  FROM portfolio_ai.facts
), years_calc AS (
  SELECT
    date_part('year', age(current_date, value::date))::int AS years,
    date_part('month', age(current_date, value::date))::int AS months,
    value::date AS start_date
  FROM portfolio_ai.facts
  WHERE key = 'experience_start_date'
), deterministic AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN i.normalized_question ~ '(cuanto|cuantos|anos|años|tiempo).*(experiencia|exp)' OR i.normalized_question ~ '(experiencia|exp).*(cuanto|cuantos|anos|años|tiempo)' THEN
      'Juan Gabriel tiene aproximadamente ' || date_part('year', age(current_date, COALESCE(y.start_date, date '2023-01-01')))::int || ' años' || CASE WHEN date_part('month', age(current_date, COALESCE(y.start_date, date '2023-01-01')))::int > 0 THEN ' y ' || date_part('month', age(current_date, COALESCE(y.start_date, date '2023-01-01')))::int || ' meses' ELSE '' END || ' de experiencia profesional, contando desde enero de 2023. Su trayectoria incluye consultoría OCI, integración Oracle APEX ↔ JD Edwards, desarrollo a medida con Laravel, automatización con n8n e IA aplicada a operaciones.'
    WHEN i.normalized_question ~ '(ia|inteligencia artificial|ai|agente|agentes|rag|notebooklm|logs|linux|monitoreo|infraestructura)' THEN
      COALESCE((SELECT value FROM portfolio_ai.facts WHERE key = 'ai_experience'), 'Juan Gabriel aplica IA y agentes para análisis de logs, monitoreo de infraestructura Linux, documentación operativa y bases de conocimiento/RAG con NotebookLM.')
    WHEN i.normalized_question ~ '(anthropic|claude|certificado|certificacion|certificación|curso|cursos)' THEN
      COALESCE((SELECT value FROM portfolio_ai.facts WHERE key = 'anthropic_academy'), 'Juan Gabriel está en formación continua en Anthropic Academy.') || ' Certificados: https://verify.skilljar.com/c/gjzgxucb6erf y https://verify.skilljar.com/c/xzddkpb4vvhr.'
    WHEN i.normalized_question ~ '(trabaja|actual|cargo|rol|empresa)' THEN
      'Juan Gabriel trabaja actualmente como ' || COALESCE((SELECT value FROM portfolio_ai.facts WHERE key = 'current_role'), 'Consultor Informático / Desarrollador en VCE Consulting') || '.'
    WHEN i.normalized_question ~ '(contacto|correo|email|whatsapp|linkedin|github)' THEN
      'Podés contactar a Juan por email: ' || COALESCE((SELECT value FROM portfolio_ai.facts WHERE key = 'email'), 'juan.gabrie.dev@gmail.com') || ', WhatsApp: ' || COALESCE((SELECT value FROM portfolio_ai.facts WHERE key = 'phone'), '+57 3138751753') || ', LinkedIn: ' || COALESCE((SELECT value FROM portfolio_ai.facts WHERE key = 'linkedin'), 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/juanga-dev/') || ' y GitHub: ' || COALESCE((SELECT value FROM portfolio_ai.facts WHERE key = 'github'), 'https://github.com/IamJuandev') || '.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS answer
  FROM input i
  LEFT JOIN years_calc y ON true
), experiences AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) - 'sort_order' ORDER BY sort_order), '[]'::jsonb) AS data FROM portfolio_ai.experience e
), projects AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) - 'sort_order' ORDER BY sort_order), '[]'::jsonb) AS data FROM portfolio_ai.projects p
), education AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ed) - 'sort_order' ORDER BY sort_order), '[]'::jsonb) AS data FROM portfolio_ai.education ed
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT answer FROM deterministic LIMIT 1), (SELECT answer FROM cache_hit LIMIT 1)) AS direct_answer,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT answer FROM deterministic LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'deterministic'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cache_hit) THEN 'cache'
    ELSE 'ai'
  END AS answer_source,
  (SELECT data FROM fact_map) AS facts_json,
  (SELECT data FROM fact_details) AS fact_details_json,
  (SELECT data FROM experiences) AS experience_json,
  (SELECT data FROM projects) AS projects_json,
  (SELECT data FROM education) AS education_json,
  (SELECT normalized_question FROM input) AS normalized_question,
  (SELECT question FROM input) AS question;` }}

={{ `WITH upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO portfolio_ai.chat_cache (normalized_question, question, answer, source)
  VALUES (
    '${$('Build DB Context').item.json.normalizedQuestion.replace(/'/g, "''")}',
    '${$('Build DB Context').item.json.question.replace(/'/g, "''")}',
    '${$json.answer.replace(/'/g, "''")}',
    'ai'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (normalized_question) DO UPDATE SET
    answer = EXCLUDED.answer,
    question = EXCLUDED.question,
    source = EXCLUDED.source,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING answer
), log AS (
  INSERT INTO portfolio_ai.chat_logs (normalized_question, question, answer, source)
  SELECT
    '${$('Build DB Context').item.json.normalizedQuestion.replace(/'/g, "''")}',
    '${$('Build DB Context').item.json.question.replace(/'/g, "''")}',
    answer,
    'ai'
  FROM upsert
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT answer FROM upsert) AS answer, 200 AS "statusCode";` }}
